summary: Nouveau Monde Graphite filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a Canadian press release furnished to the SEC) disclosing that accrued third-quarter 2026 interest on an unsecured convertible note held by Investissement Québec will be settled in shares rather than cash. The company will issue 283,265 common shares at US$1.21, an aggregate US$342,751 payment, subject to TSX and NYSE approval and a four-month-plus-one-day hold period. Because the holder owns more than 10% of securities, it is a related-party transaction under Regulation 61-101, though the company invoked minority-approval and valuation exemptions since the value falls below 25% of market capitalization.
